hialeah-2025-12-09-10L.en: The minutes print "APPROVED 5-1", but they list five members present and all five voting yes. Shown here as 5-0.
hialeah-2025-12-09-10L.es: El acta dice "APROBADO 5-1", pero indica cinco miembros presentes y los cinco votando a favor. Aquí aparece como 5-0.
hialeah-2025-12-09-10L.ht: Rapò reyinyon an ekri "APWOUVE 5-1", men li bay senk manm ki te la epi tout senk te vote wi. Nou montre l isit la kòm 5-0.

hialeah-2025-08-12-10FF.en: The minutes name the vendor "Office Compass Solutions". The company registered with the state is Compass Office Solutions LLC (Sunbiz M06000000058).
hialeah-2025-08-12-10FF.es: El acta nombra al proveedor "Office Compass Solutions". La empresa registrada en el estado es Compass Office Solutions LLC (Sunbiz M06000000058).
hialeah-2025-08-12-10FF.ht: Rapò reyinyon an rele founisè a "Office Compass Solutions". Konpayi ki anrejistre nan Leta a se Compass Office Solutions LLC (Sunbiz M06000000058).
